exposure_definition: Total complete original-text input presentations over the entire new run, not repetitions per epoch and not a guarantee of per-token loss inclusion.
cohort_assignment: Not performed. Requires verified overlap findings and frozen article manifest before proceeding.
background_membership: Pending pool size and target/control split; strict-disjoint leftover articles preferred.
occurrence_schedule: Deterministic, balanced interleaving across the full run; record exact identity, ordinal, stream offsets, and update/block membership; no subsequent epoch/block reshuffle that invalidates schedule.
packing: Original content + one native EOS, no BOS or chat template; concatenate and pack 4096 tokens; retain unpadded tail; never truncate or drop article suffixes.
exposure_accounting: Assert requested occurrence counts before and after schedule compilation. Log actual tokens consumed, EOS, article spans, block boundaries, repeated copies within updates, and LLaDA masked-token coverage. AR first block tokens have no next-token target.
base_initialization: Each model starts from its original pinned base checkpoint.
differences_from_previous: Explicit nonuniform total occurrence schedule replaces three identical epochs.
Random-length cropping disabled to retain all scheduled source tokens.
Corpus deduplicated and screened for near-duplicates and long shared passages.
Learning-rate step counts recomputed from actual native-token block counts; schedule proportions preserved.
New balanced occurrence order replaces frozen old article order and epoch block shuffling.
execution_plan: Pending full-token training feasibility probes after corpus review. Independent single-GPU model workers in waves preserve microbatch/accumulation; no distributed batch-size change is implied.
storage: Weights/caches/data on pod. Only final BF16 weights and small artifacts on Drive, with resumable uploads and checksums; Drive auth/quota not yet checked.
evaluation: Untouched-base versus final comparison on the same frozen article-relative windows, common extraction settings, article-level aggregation, and 0-exposure controls; do not select articles by extraction outcome.
prerequisites: Disjointness audit completed and reported to user before training.
Frozen targets/control/background membership and occurrence manifest.
Native token counts and masks/loss coverage verified for each model.
Original OLMo unscaled 4096 vs native 2048 context limitation retained and disclosed.
Hugging Face gated access, CPU-master optimizer memory, Drive quota/auth, and final-save feasibility checked.

definitions.exact: Original whitespace-collapse SHA256-equivalent text equality; original contents preserved.
definitions.words: Unicode NFKC, casefold, Unicode word tokens; audit only.
definitions.strict: Also exclude any literal consecutive 50 canonical words shared with old training. Includes boilerplate.
definitions.internal: One longest representative per connected component under the same overlap rules.
definitions.evaluation_length: 200 to 1500 canonical words; proposed target/control eligibility only.

limitations: Disjointness is relative to the prior fine-tuning corpus, not undocumented base pretraining.
Semantic paraphrases and shorter shared passages may remain; this is an explicit lexical audit.
